items: Constructor: a special method that initializes an object's attributes when it is created; in Python it is __init__().
Destructor: __del__() is called when an object is deleted and is used for clean-up.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)
blocks.text:
class Car:
....def __init__(self, color):
........self.color = color

....def __del__(self):
........print("Car with color", self.color, "is being deleted.")
